_note: TPO15 오답 패턴용 Transfer 문제 (AI 작성, 원본 문장·정답 재사용 없음). 초점: 숫자·시간이 가리키는 대상 확인, 사후 돌봄 vs 사전 예방(동사 시점), 파생어 의미(narration/narrative), 나열을 묶는 복수 명사, Were you able to / Did you manage to → 결과로 답하기, 대조 신호(in contrast)로 Main Purpose, mentioned challenge만 고르기.

lines.t: Did you manage to get tickets for the concert?
Were you able to fix the printer this morning?
Listen to a talk in an agriculture class.
Two methods of farming are often compared.
In conventional farming, a single crop is planted across a large field year after year.
This approach is efficient for harvesting machines, but it drains the same nutrients from the soil every season, so farmers must add more and more fertilizer.
Crop rotation, in contrast, changes what is grown in a field from one year to the next.
For example, a farmer might plant corn one year and beans the next.
Beans return nitrogen to the soil, so the following crop needs less fertilizer.
Crop rotation does have drawbacks, though.
Farmers have to learn how to grow and sell several different crops, and in the first few years their income can be less predictable.

items.passage:
Hi Jordan,

The volunteer orientation for the city library's summer reading festival will be held on Saturday from 10:00 A.M. to noon in Room 204. The festival itself opens the following Monday and runs for two weeks. Please bring a photo ID so we can print your volunteer badge.

Thanks,
Priya

qs.prompt: What can be concluded about the festival?
options: It lasts two hours.
It is organized by a public library.
It takes place in Room 204.
It begins on Saturday.
why: 2시간은 orientation의 시간 — 질문 대상(festival)과 다름
✓ the city library's summer reading festival
Room 204는 orientation 장소
Saturday는 orientation 날짜. 축제는 다음 월요일 시작
qs.evidence: The volunteer orientation for the city library's summer reading festival will be held on Saturday from 10:00 A.M. to noon in Room 204.

items.passage: Honeybee colonies divide labor among workers of different ages. Older workers forage for food outside the hive, while younger ones stay inside. When a larva hatches, the young nurse bees feed it several times an hour until it can care for itself.

qs.prompt: What is one effect of the division of labor described in the passage?
options: It prevents larvae from hatching too early.
It ensures that newly hatched larvae are fed.
It stops older bees from leaving the hive.
It makes all workers forage equally.
why: 부화 '후' 먹이 주기만 나옴 — 부화 시기 조절(사전 예방)은 원문에 없음
✓ nurse bees feed it until it can care for itself
반대: older workers forage outside
반대: 나이에 따라 일을 나눔
qs.evidence: When a larva hatches, the young nurse bees feed it several times an hour until it can care for itself.

ctest.text: The documentary has almost no dialogue; instead, a calm {{}} by the director guides viewers through each scene.

items.explain: a calm ___ by the director guides viewers = 감독이 '말로 설명하는 행위·목소리' → narration (단수, a 뒤). narrative(이야기 내용)는 by the director가 '읽어 주는' 행위와 맞지 않음

ctest.text: Dance, theater, and music are all performing arts, and each of these {{}} requires years of practice.

items.explain: each of these + 복수 명사 = 앞에 나열한 dance, theater, music을 묶는 말 → pursuits(활동·분야)

qs.prompt: What is the main purpose of the talk?
options: To compare two approaches to growing crops
To explain the history of crop rotation
To describe how harvesting machines work
To argue that fertilizer should be banned
why: ✓ conventional farming → in contrast → crop rotation: 두 방식 대조
역사(연도·발전 과정)는 강의에 없음
machines는 장점 설명의 세부
fertilizer 금지 주장은 없음 — 과잉 추론
qs.evidence: Crop rotation, in contrast, changes what is grown in a field from one year to the next.

qs.prompt: What drawback of crop rotation is mentioned in the talk?
options: It requires buying new harvesting machines.
It makes farmers' income less predictable at first.
It removes nitrogen from the soil.
It needs more fertilizer than conventional farming.
why: 기계가 새로 필요하다는 말은 없음 — 그럴듯한 추론
✓ in the first few years their income can be less predictable
반대: beans return nitrogen
반대: 다음 작물은 비료가 덜 필요
qs.evidence: in the first few years their income can be less predictable
